title: Quality Studio analysis evidence
description: One durable pipeline result produced by an in-process Quality Studio analysis step.

schema.description: Version token for this evidence envelope.

stepId.description: Stable Agent Studio pipeline step identifier.

analysis.description: Named Quality Studio package analysis requested by the step.

packageVersion.description: In-process Quality Studio package version used for the run.

repositoryPath.description: Absolute repository path supplied to the analysis core.

repositoryRuleConfig.description: Versioned in-repository rule override path consumed by Quality Studio.

requestedPaths.description: Repository-relative paths selected by the card-class policy.

analyses.description: Quality Studio result objects, preserved without duplicating rule definitions.

status.description: Terminal status of the analysis step.

startedAt.description: UTC time at which analysis began.

completedAt.description: UTC time at which the evidence was completed.
